definitions.content: load cell which is capable of performing the functions as described under "analog-passive" load cell and which also utilizes active electronics

notes.content: This type of load cell may utilize the active electronics for gaining an electronic representation of the measurand value, active temperature compensation, and similar functions being of influence to the measurand value.

definitions.content: cellule de pesée capable de remplir les fonctions de la cellule de pesée analogique passive et qui utilise également des composantes électroniques actives
